title: Genesis Bible Quiz - Chapter 12
description: Ten questions on Genesis 12: God's call and promise to Abram, his journey through Canaan, and his stay in Egypt.

questions.text: What did Yahweh tell Abram to do?
questions.explanation: Yahweh told Abram to leave his country, his relatives and his father's house, and go to the land He would show him.

answers.text: Build a tower that reaches to the sky
Leave his country for a land God would show him
Go down into Egypt and live there
Build a ship to escape the waters

questions.text: Who would be blessed through Abram, according to God's promise?
questions.explanation: God said, "All the families of the earth will be blessed through you."

answers.text: All the families of the earth

questions.text: How old was Abram when he departed from Haran?
questions.explanation: Abram was seventy-five years old when he departed from Haran.
Abram took Sarai his wife and Lot his brother's son, and they went into the land of Canaan.

questions.text: Where did Abram go as he passed through the land?
questions.explanation: Abram passed through the land to the place of Shechem, to the oak of Moreh.

answers.text: Shechem, to the oak of Moreh

questions.text: What did Yahweh promise when He appeared to Abram at Shechem?
questions.explanation: Yahweh appeared to Abram and said, "I will give this land to your offspring." Abram built an altar there.

questions.text: Between which two places did Abram pitch his tent?
questions.explanation: Abram pitched his tent on the mountain east of Bethel, having Bethel on the west and Ai on the east.

questions.text: Why did Abram go down into Egypt?
questions.explanation: There was a famine in the land, and Abram went down into Egypt because the famine was severe.

answers.text: There was a war in Canaan

questions.text: What did Abram ask Sarai to say in Egypt?
questions.explanation: Abram asked Sarai to say that she was his sister, so that it would be well with him and his life would be spared.

questions.text: What did Yahweh do to Pharaoh and his house because of Sarai?
questions.explanation: Yahweh afflicted Pharaoh and his house with great plagues because of Sarai, Abram's wife.

answers.text: He afflicted them with great plagues
He sent a flood on Egypt
